literal.prompt: Какой морской парк у побережья Квинсленда охраняет крупнейшую в мире систему коралловых рифов?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: PASS factual: Reef Authority L15-L19 expressly describes the named Marine Park management/protection role and L60-L69 management tools and partnership. UNESCO L5/L27,L50-L63 establishes world’s largest reef ecosystem and Queensland coast (L61), L83-L85 links most of property to federal GBR Marine Park and its authority. Candidate asks the protected marine park safeguarding that system, not simply naming the physical reef. Only slot0 meets complete current Queensland/largest-reef/protected-park relation among the four supplied parks.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.editorialGround: Actual current prompt restricts answer to a marine park off Queensland protecting a coral-reef system. Correct label alone fully repeats морской парк and риф, whereas three alternatives are bare national-park names. This is not a suffix/length-only rejection: full primary contexts show Uluru–Kata Tjuta is a red-sand, inland central-Australian desert/monolith park far from coastal cities (UNESCO L5,L52-L54), so it gives no credible marine/coral confusion in this exact question. Kakadu has real tidal/coastal wetlands (UNESCO L5,L46,L52) and Fiordland has actual marine reserves/fjords (DOC MilfordL18 and DoubtfulL16), so these two are not rejected merely as land parks; nevertheless the complete set lacks three plausible competing marine-reef protected areas, and its sole explicit marine/reef label offers a strong category shortcut before comparing facts.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Это Морской парк Большого Барьерного рифа. Его границы охватывают большую часть одноимённого объекта Всемирного наследия.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: PASS: Reef Authority L62 says Marine Park extends over99percent of World Heritage Area. UNESCO L83 says most of property is within federal Marine Park, approximately99percent, and L84-L94 distinguishes Queensland islands/state coast park and complementary management. Current explanation says большая часть, correctly avoiding identity of every World Heritage boundary or100percent coverage.

Note says it manages park, not that it is the only participant; Reef Authority L68-L70 joint management context does not contradict that. Specific governmental agency is useful extra beyond requested park identity/location/protected reef.
